# AI Agent Memory

> Long-term, team-wide memory for AI agents, served over the Model Context
> Protocol. Open source and multi-tenant: agents file verbatim memories into a
> per-team memory palace and recall them across sessions with hybrid semantic
> search (vector similarity, BM25 and a closet boost). Free to start, self-hostable.

Every document below is plain Markdown, written to be read by a model rather than
rendered. The `/ai/` bundle follows the Open Knowledge Format (OKF) v0.2, so each
file carries YAML frontmatter with a `type`.

## Docs

- [What AI Agent Memory is]({{BASE_URL}}/ai/landing.md): the product, the memory-palace data model (wing, room, drawer, closet, hallway, tunnel, knowledge graph), the four-step MCP flow, capabilities, pricing and the full FAQ. Start here.
- [Sandboxed installs]({{BASE_URL}}/ai/sandboxes.md): one isolated agent config per project under `~/.sandboxes/<name>`, the verified per-agent matrix for Claude Code, Codex and pi, and what `init` / `load` commit to a repository.
- [Agent self-install, CLI]({{BASE_URL}}/ai/claude-guide.md): how a coding agent installs the kit and registers the MCP server on its own, on macOS or Linux.
- [Setup without the CLI]({{BASE_URL}}/ai/windows-guide.md): Windows, VS Code, Cursor and Claude Desktop connect to the remote MCP server by hand-written config, because the bash installer cannot run there.
- [Connect any agent (MCP install)]({{BASE_URL}}/ai/install-memory-mcp.md): the harness-agnostic registration route — a URL and a bearer token, `mcp add` commands for Claude Code and codex, JSON config for VS Code/Cursor/Claude Desktop, and what to do on a host we have not verified. Works on Windows, where the CLI installer cannot run.
- [Bootstrap memory]({{BASE_URL}}/ai/bootstrap-memory.md): the memory model a team builds once the MCP is connected — wings and rooms, the two auto-loaded skills, knowledge-graph scoping, recall, continuity, and the acceptance test. Not an install guide.
- [Bundle index]({{BASE_URL}}/ai/index.md): the OKF bundle's own table of contents.

## Install guides (authoritative, served as Markdown)

- [/claude-guide]({{BASE_URL}}/claude-guide): the full agent-facing install guide. Paste its URL into a coding agent and it performs the install, asking you for the workspace token it must not invent.
- [/windows-guide]({{BASE_URL}}/windows-guide): the full no-CLI setup guide, with per-client MCP config paths for VS Code, Cursor and Claude Desktop.
- [/install-memory-mcp]({{BASE_URL}}/install-memory-mcp): the full connect-any-client guide. Paste its URL into any coding assistant and it registers the MCP server, then hands off to /bootstrap-memory.
- [/bootstrap-memory]({{BASE_URL}}/bootstrap-memory): the full memory-model document. Hand its URL to a coding agent and say "implement memory from this"; it assumes the MCP is already connected and never installs anything.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt]({{BASE_URL}}/llms-full.txt): every document above concatenated into a single fetch.
- [Sitemap index]({{BASE_URL}}/sitemap.xml): points at the page sitemap and the AI sitemap.
- [AI sitemap]({{BASE_URL}}/ai-sitemap.xml): every document in the `/ai/` bundle.
- [Source code](https://github.com/atvirokodosprendimai/agentsmemory): the Go server, open source and self-hostable.
- [Landing page]({{BASE_URL}}/): the HTML original the bundle mirrors.
- [Sandbox guide]({{BASE_URL}}/sandboxes): the HTML original of the sandbox documentation.
